title: Putnami Agent Context Document or Overrides File
description: The two agent-context wire shapes: the per-project Document that aggregates a project's orientation facts by reference, and the author-owned OverridesFile that narrows deterministic selection. A document is exactly one of the two.

rootKind.description: The kind of a composition root. Closed enum; adding a kind requires a protocol version bump.

sourceReason.description: Why a representative source range was selected. Closed enum; adding a reason requires a protocol version bump.

docRelationship.description: Whether a doc-to-code relationship was verified. Closed enum; adding a status requires a protocol version bump.

testPolicy.description: How the test tooling behaves; mirrors database TestMode. Closed enum; adding a value requires a protocol version bump.

absenceReason.description: Machine-readable reason a tests section carries no packs. Closed enum; adding a reason requires a protocol version bump.

tokenMethod.description: How a token estimate was computed. Closed enum; adding a method requires a protocol version bump.

aggregationMethod.description: How the document aggregates project facts. Closed enum; adding a method requires a protocol version bump.

digest.description: Content address in sha256:<64 lowercase hex> form.

relativePath.description: A non-empty workspace-relative POSIX path (no leading '/' and no '..' segment).

identity.description: Project identity and dependency graph — workspace-owned facts only.

languages.description: Languages the project is written in.

dependencies.description: Ids of projects this project depends on.

dependents.description: Ids of projects that depend on this project.

compositionRoot.description: One entrypoint into the project's wiring — kind, path, provenance only.

provenance.description: Short tag naming how the root was identified.

sensitive.description: Marks a root pointing at caller-flagged sensitive material.

artifactRef.description: A reference to a committed artifact by path + digest; never embedded content.

kind.description: Optional within-section disambiguator (e.g. an infra 'secret' kind).

sensitive.description: Marks a reference to caller-flagged sensitive material.

tokenEstimate.description: Token-budget estimate for a referenced range, with the method that produced it.

estimated.description: Estimated token count for the range.

sourceRange.description: A representative slice of a source file by path + line range — never content.

sensitive.description: Marks a range in caller-flagged sensitive material.

docRef.description: An adjacent documentation reference with a checked/unchecked relationship status.

sensitive.description: Marks a doc in caller-flagged sensitive material.

packRef.description: A conformance-pack reference mirroring conformance/pack.json (id, capabilityKinds, languages).

languages.description: Language adapters that ship a runner.

testsSection.description: The optional tests section: packs + policy + fixture digests, or an absence reason.

absenceReason.description: Why packs is empty; required when packs is empty, forbidden otherwise.

operationalSurface.description: Refs-only hints about a project's runtime surface.

platformEndpoints.description: Whether the project exposes the platform operational endpoints.

configSection.description: Config schema reference and operational surface hints — references only.

schemaRef.description: Committed config schema by path + digest.

generator.description: The tool that produced the document.

provenance.description: Freshness and origin: workspace revision, generator, aggregation method.

workspaceRevision.description: Workspace revision the document was computed at.

document.description: The per-project agent-context artifact emitted to <project>/.gen/agent-context.json.

overridesFile.description: The author-owned schema/agent-context.overrides.json that narrows deterministic selection.

removeSources.description: Source paths to drop from the selection.
